name: Gossiped Comments
author: gossiped

sections.description:
Gossiped Comments replaces the default WordPress commenting system with a powerful, universal commenting platform that works across multiple websites.

Key Features:

  • Cross-Site Profiles – Users maintain one profile across all sites using Gossiped
  • Reputation System – Build reputation through quality comments and engagement
  • Real-Time Analytics – Track comment activity, user engagement, and site performance
  • Spam Protection – Built-in spam filtering and moderation tools
  • Modern Interface – Clean, responsive design with light/dark themes
  • Nested Replies – Unlimited reply depth with threaded conversations
  • Upvote/Downvote – Community-driven content rating
  • Live Activity Tracking – See who’s viewing and commenting in real-time
  • Email Notifications – Notify users of replies and new comments
  • Per-Post Control – Enable/disable comments on individual posts
  • Easy Moderation – Powerful admin tools to moderate, ban, and suspend users

Why Gossiped?

Traditional WordPress comments are isolated to each site. With Gossiped, your commenters build a reputation across the web, encouraging quality discussions and reducing spam.

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Create a free account at Gossiped.com
  3. Add your site and get your API key
  4. Enter the API key in WordPress settings
  5. Comments automatically appear on your posts

Privacy & Data:

  • Comments are stored on Gossiped’s secure servers
  • Full GDPR compliance
  • Users control their own data and profiles
  • No tracking scripts or cookies without consent

Privacy Policy

Gossiped Comments connects to the Gossiped API (gossiped.com) to store and retrieve comments. When users comment, the following data is sent to Gossiped:

  • User’s name and email (if provided)
  • Comment content
  • Page URL and title
  • IP address (for spam protection)
  • User agent string

This data is stored on Gossiped’s secure servers. Users can delete their data at any time through their Gossiped account.

For full privacy details, see: https://gossiped.com/privacy

Support

For support, please visit:
* Support Forum: https://gossiped.com/support
* Documentation: https://gossiped.com/docs
* Email: support@gossiped.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Gossiped Comments”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Setup:

  1. Go to Settings > Gossiped Comments
  2. Sign up at Gossiped.com if you haven’t already
  3. Add your website in your Gossiped dashboard
  4. Copy your API key
  5. Paste it into the WordPress settings and save
  6. Your site will be automatically verified
sections.faq:
Do I need a Gossiped account?

Yes, you need to create a free account at Gossiped.com to get an API key. This allows you to manage comments and access analytics from the Gossiped dashboard.

Is it free?

Yes, Gossiped is completely free for personal blogs and small sites. We offer premium plans for high-traffic sites with advanced features.

Will this replace my existing WordPress comments?

Yes, Gossiped can replace the default WordPress commenting system. You can also use it alongside WordPress comments or manually place it using shortcodes.

Can I migrate my existing WordPress comments?

Currently, automatic migration is not available, but it’s on our roadmap. You can keep your old comments visible while new comments use Gossiped.

What about spam?

Gossiped includes advanced spam protection, rate limiting, and moderation tools. Users with low reputation scores are automatically flagged for review.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, Gossiped is fully GDPR compliant. Users have full control over their data and can delete their accounts at any time.

Can users comment without registering?

No, users must have a Gossiped account to comment. This helps maintain quality discussions and reduces spam. Registration is quick and easy.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can choose between light and dark themes. Custom CSS support is coming soon.

How do I moderate comments?

Go to your WordPress admin > Gossiped in the sidebar. You can approve, delete, and manage comments. You can also moderate from the Gossiped dashboard.

Can I ban users?

Yes, you can ban or suspend users from your site through the moderation panel. Bans are site-specific and don’t affect other sites.

What analytics are included?

View comment volume, top commenters, article performance, geographic distribution, engagement patterns, and live viewer counts.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, Gossiped works with all major caching plugins including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache.

Can I use it with other themes?

Yes, Gossiped works with any WordPress theme.

Where can I get support?

Visit gossiped.com/support or email support@gossiped.com
